Actum Est: Shooting an enemy with this weapon will give 1 stack. • At 100 stacks the next magazine will be filled with shock ammo.
Behind You: Amplifies weapon damage by +20% to enemies that are not targeting you.
Brazen: Receive +3.5% Amplified Damage on the next shot with the weapon for each pellet that hits the target, if at least 6 pellets hit.
Capacitance: Shooting enemies builds stacks to a cap of 40. Each stack grants 1.5% Skill Damage. After 5 seconds, stacks decay 1 per second. • For each Skill Tier gain 7.5% Weapon Damage.
Capitulate: Hitting an enemy applies -4% Movement Speed for each pellet hit for 5 seconds. • Shooting the enemy again will reapply the stacks.
Determined: Killing a target reduces skill cooldowns by 7.5%.
Flatline: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to pulsed enemies. • After 3 kills, applies pulse to the next enemy you hit.
Future Perfect: Weapon kills grant +1 skill tier for 15s. Stacks up to 3 times. • Weapon kills at skill tier 6 grant overcharge for 15s. Overcharge cooldown: 90s
Mosquito Song: Hitting an enemy applies a stack. Stacks are shared between players. • At 5 stacks, the enemy will forcefully target the last player to apply a stack for 5s and take 25% more damage to armor.
Ortiz Assault Interface: While scoped, the weapon will highlight a random body section of each enemy. • The weapon deals +60% Weapon Damage to highlighted body sections.
Payment in Kind: Dealing damage to enemies adds a stack of +2% critical hit damage, up to 100 stacks, lasting 10s. • On reload apply a 10s bleed to yourself, which deals 0.5% armor damage per stack.
Precision Strike: Killing enemies farther than 20m builds up stacks. Max stack is 3. • Hitting an enemy within 20m will use all stacks to provide +20% Amplified Damage to enemies within 20m for 5s.
Pressure Point: Amplifies weapon damage by 15% to enemies under Status Effects.
Primer Rounds: Damaged enemies lose 50% burn resistance for 5 seconds.
Sledgehammer: Dealing damage with a grenade applies a mark on target. • Targets with mark will take 15% more damage to armor and have a -20% movement speed. • Mark will disappear after 10 seconds.
Stabilize: Firing your weapon increases Weapon Accuracy by 1% and Weapon Stability by 1% per shot, up to 60%. • If you stop firing, the bonuses reset after 4 seconds.
Startling: Whenever this weapon makes and enemy Suppressed, the enemy is applied Disorient, and you and allies receive +30% Damage to Targets Out of Cover for 15s
Symbiosis: While having a Shield deployed, lose Shield Health at a rate of 10% per second. • Your Shield receives repairs of 25% of the damage dealt by this weapon.
Thunder Strike: Amplifies weapon damage by 30% to shocked enemies. • After 4 kills, applies shock to the next enemy you hit.
Twinkling Lights: Only at night with twinkling lights can you fill their heads with festive might.
